top_signals.title: Humble Robotics raises $51M for cabless hauler pilots
top_signals.summary:
Humble Robotics raised a $51 million Series A to push its cabless, electric Humble Hauler into customer pilots, testing and early manufacturing for dock-to-dock freight.
